page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.3xlarge is an x86_64 virtual instance from the high clock speed ecs.hfr7 family, virtualized on KVM. It is powered by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor operating at a base clock frequency of 3.3 GHz. The configuration allocates 12 dedicated vCPUs mapped across 6 physical cores with two threads per core. System memory is sized at 96 GB, yielding an 8 GB per vCPU allocation that positions the server strongly for memory-intensive computations. The instance lacks local storage, requiring network-attached storage for persistence, and contains no dedicated GPU hardware. Networking throughput is defined by a 4 Gbps baseline.

Instruction set support includes AVX-512 extensions such as AVX-512 VNNI and AVX-512 BF16, complemented by standard AES encryption and BMI2 instructions, backed by a 33 MB L3 cache. Benchmark testing positions the CPU in the median tier across general compute metrics, achieving a multi-core score of 6723 in Geekbench and 12473.75 in multi-core stress-ng. Memory throughput remains steady under load, recording 69.85 GB/s read and 46.64 GB/s write speeds across large 256 MB blocks, while cached read speeds reach 698.81 GB/s. Static web serving reaches 10.32 GB/s, and in-memory key-value operations demonstrate strong transactional speed, processing 11.99 million Redis SET operations per second.

Hardware tradeoffs focus on high memory density and elevated CPU clock rates rather than local I/O throughput or hardware acceleration. In the absence of bundled NVMe storage, disk performance is tied to network block storage volumes. While small 135M parameter LLM inference runs smoothly at 159.56 generation tokens per second, 7B model execution falls to weak percentiles, highlighting the limits of running larger model inference on CPU cores without accelerator hardware. From an infrastructure cost perspective, the instance delivers high resource density per vCPU, avoiding the overhead of specialized GPU silicon. It is well matched to in-memory caching layers, Redis clusters, relational databases, software compilation, and data transformation jobs.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.3xlarge is a high clock speed virtual server based on the x86_64 architecture, running on KVM. It features an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor clocked at 3.3 GHz, configured with 12 dedicated vCPUs across 6 physical cores, and paired with 96 GB of system RAM. This provides a generous 8 GB per vCPU ratio suitable for memory-demanding tasks. The instance does not include integrated local disk storage or hardware GPU accelerators, relying on a 4 Gbps baseline network interface. Benchmark results indicate balanced performance, highlighted by 11.99 million Redis SET operations per second, 69.85 GB/s uncached memory read bandwidth, and solid compilation performance under Clang. Due to the lack of dedicated accelerators, large model inference remains constrained. The server is well matched to in-memory databases, Redis deployments, data processing pipelines, and enterprise application hosting.
